title: Panda Adventure level configuration
description: Authoritative config for the S9 level authority (gADR-0010): the Great-Wall blockout segments, the backdrop, the Arena interval that clamps the Warp Blink's landing, and the End screen's blockout numbers (the End-screen font sizes migrated to scale_spec.json — gADR-0013 — composed back in by the builder). Converted to data/generated/level_config.tres (a LevelConfig Resource) by scripts/build_config.py. Cross-field rules (unique platform names, a real Arena interval) live in validate_level_semantics.

background_color.description: Level backdrop clear color as RGBA, each component in 0..1 — the black-hole-edge flavor.

background_asset.description: Optional view asset reference for the level backdrop (P2-S2, #436): a res:// path or asset-pipeline id; absent (or empty) keeps the clear-color backdrop. Authored empty until an asset slice fills it (asset references are data, gADR-0000); today's backdrop is a clear color with no view node, so nothing consumes a non-empty value yet.

platform_color.description: Shared color of every Great-Wall segment as RGBA, each component in 0..1 — one wall, one material.

platforms.description: The Great-Wall blockout: ordered named segments, runtime-instanced by the level (gADR-0010). At least one segment — a level with no ground is a config bug.

name.description: Segment node name — unique across the list (it becomes a sibling of the spawns under Main; the gADR-0005 addressability argument).

position.description: Segment center position (x, y) in pixels — the StaticBody2D origin.

size.description: Segment block size (width, height) in pixels; each strictly positive AND a multiple of the Scale spec's tile_size, so the View skin's tile vocabulary composes on the grid (build_config.validate_scale_semantics, gADR-0013).

asset.description: Optional view asset reference for this segment's block (P2-S2, #436): a res:// path or asset-pipeline id the view seam resolves; absent (or empty) renders the colored-block fallback. Authored empty until an asset slice fills it (asset references are data, gADR-0000).

arena_min_x.description: West edge of the Arena — the authored combat span whose interval clamps the Warp Blink's landing (gADR-0010). Must stay strictly below arena_max_x (validate_level_semantics).

arena_max_x.description: East edge of the Arena; strictly above arena_min_x (validate_level_semantics).

end_overlay_color.description: End screen full-screen dim color as RGBA, each component in 0..1 (the alpha is the dim strength).

end_win_color.description: End screen title color for the won End state, RGBA in 0..1.

end_lose_color.description: End screen title color for the lost End state, RGBA in 0..1.

end_fade_duration.description: Seconds for the End screen fade-in tween; strictly positive.
